network.input: x_t float32[N,1,16,16]; t int64[N] in0..31; clean images in[-1,1]
network.forward: concat x_t with t/31 broadcast as second channel; conv1(2->32,3,pad1),ReLU; conv2(32->64,3,pad1),ReLU; conv3(64->64,3,pad1),ReLU; out(64->1,3,pad1), no output activation
network.objective: Minimize per-example pixel-mean squared error between epsilon prediction and sampled Gaussian epsilon. GEPA maximizes negative MSE.
network.sampler: 32-step cosine-schedule DDPM; predicted x0 clipped[-1,1]; stochastic posterior with zero noise at final step
network.conventions: PyTorch convolution cross-correlation weights[out,in,kernel_row,kernel_col], stride1. All source arrays and coefficients are full precision in edit(w,f).
